title: Recirculation Filter Housing Change and Cabin Air Manifold Reseal
abstract: Introduces a recirculation filter housing that can be changed without disturbing the manifold joint, and reseals the cabin air manifold to a standard that survives the filter change cycle, cutting a recurring source of bleed-through noise complaints.

sections.reason: Filter changes at the six month interval were disturbing the manifold joint immediately downstream, and roughly one change in five produced a whistle that the cabin crew reported as a noise complaint on the following sector. Line stations were resealing the joint each time, outside any published task, and the sealant used varied. Nine operators raised the point at the technical review and it appeared in the cabin dissatisfaction top ten for two consecutive years.
sections.description: The filter housing is replaced by a variant with a quarter turn cover on the access side, so the element can be changed without breaking the manifold joint at all. The manifold itself is replaced by the kit variant with an integrated seal at the flange rather than a separate collar, and the restrictor downstream is retained. The recirculation sensor position is unchanged. The assembly drawing is reissued to show the cover swing and the clearance needed in the ceiling void, which is the only installation constraint the change introduces.
sections.effects: Mass increase of two point one kilograms per side. No electrical load change. Interchangeable at aircraft level. Filter change time falls from ninety to thirty-five minutes and no longer requires a leak check, which is the main operator benefit. The cleaning task is reissued and the six month interval is retained. No dispatch or crew effect.
sections.embodiment_note: Cut in at MSN M00412. Retrofit is by bulletin at any A check, four hours per side working from the ceiling void access panels; revision two of the bulletin corrects the clearance figure quoted for the aft installation.

type_data.production_impact: Cut in at MSN M00412, ceiling void routing unchanged
